docker.reason: Capture must run on the Windows host next to the game, NVENC, WASAPI loopback, and the webcam. Docker Desktop on Windows adds WSL2 RAM cost, does not hook fullscreen games, and GPU-PV is for compute/transcode — not Game Capture.

install_policy.ready_means: Every required dependency is present, verified, and capture preflight did not fail. The installer must not leave a Ready state if recording cannot start.

required_host.name: .NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)
required_host.notes: Host capture service and desk UI shell. Desktop runtime covers Windows-native APIs.

required_host.name: FFmpeg with NVENC
required_host.notes: Remux, proxies, commit transcodes. Isolated masters should encode via NVENC, not libx264, while a game is running.

required_host.name: NVIDIA GPU with NVENC (8 GB class accepted)
required_host.notes: Jack: RTX 5060 8 GB (Blackwell, 1x 9th-gen NVENC). Do not silently replace GPU drivers. Verify nvidia-smi and NVENC. Leftover VRAM budget is ~2 GB while gaming. System RAM is 16 GB — keep the recorder native and small.

required_host.name: NVIDIA Game Ready / NVIDIA App driver with NVENC
required_host.notes: Driver installs need a reboot and can upset games. Offer NVIDIA App; never force-install without Jack confirming.

required_devices.name: WASAPI loopback / desktop audio
required_devices.notes: Inbox on Windows. No extra package.

soft_requirements.name: Two monitors
soft_requirements.notes: Game on monitor 1, desk console on monitor 2. Single monitor is not a hard install failure.

soft_requirements.name: Private LAN / Wi-Fi for Android companion

optional.name: OBS Studio
optional.notes: Fallback capture backend only. Not the default while gaming (compositor VRAM). Do not auto-start OBS on login.

optional.name: Google Chrome
optional.notes: Monitor-2 UI works in Edge. Chrome is optional.

gateway.notes: Spare cycles on Ian's GPU are not in scope. Jack's recorder must not depend on another machine.

companion.name: Jack Session Console companion APK
companion.notes: Installed on the phone, not by the PC installer. PC installer prints pairing QR after host is Ready.

forbidden_as_required.name: Docker Desktop
forbidden_as_required.reason: Not used for capture, preview, or the companion. Do not install as part of Jack's setup.

forbidden_as_required.name: CUDA Toolkit
forbidden_as_required.reason: NVENC is in the driver. CUDA toolkit is compile-time bloat and VRAM-adjacent software Jack does not need.

forbidden_as_required.name: Python as a host runtime
forbidden_as_required.reason: Capture service is native (.NET). Python may appear later for offline detectors, never on the game-time path.

publish_secrets.name: YouTube Data API OAuth client (Jack's Google account)
publish_secrets.notes: Configured in the studio after a committed recording exists. Never a reason to mark the recorder Ready.
